/-!
# CAMBRIAN C: time-varying nondeterministic history realization

Lean 4.14, core + Std only.  No topology library is imported.
This is the finitely branching (Koenig) specialization of the dossier's
compact closed-graph realization theorem, not its full topological proof.

State types may change with time.  The transition relation need not be
deterministic, stationary, total, or invertible.  Each source state has a
COMPLETE finite list of possible successors.  An arbitrarily extendable
state then has one genuine infinite compatible history.  The selected
branch is classical and need not be computable from finite data.
-/
namespace ObservationalSUCC

universe u

def CambrianCanFollow {S : Nat → Type u}
    (R : (t : Nat) → S t → S (t+1) → Prop) :
    (t : Nat) → Nat → S t → Prop
  | _, 0, _ => True
  | t, d+1, s => ∃ next : S (t+1),
      R t s next ∧ CambrianCanFollow R (t+1) d next

theorem cambrian_can_follow_truncate
    {S : Nat → Type u}
    (R : (t : Nat) → S t → S (t+1) → Prop) :
    ∀ d t (s : S t) e, e ≤ d →
      CambrianCanFollow R t d s → CambrianCanFollow R t e s := by
  intro d
  induction d with
  | zero =>
      intro t s e he _
      have : e = 0 := by omega
      subst e
      trivial
  | succ d ih =>
      intro t s e he path
      cases e with
      | zero => trivial
      | succ e =>
          obtain ⟨next, edge, tail⟩ := path
          exact ⟨next, edge, ih (t+1) next e (by omega) tail⟩

/-- A finite menu cannot offer arbitrarily deep coherent witnesses unless
one menu member itself survives every depth.  Completeness of the menu
and downward closure are explicit hypotheses. -/
theorem cambrian_finite_coherent_choice
    {X : Type u} (menu : List X) (P : Nat → X → Prop)
    (down : ∀ e d x, e ≤ d → P d x → P e x)
    (every : ∀ d, ∃ x, x ∈ menu ∧ P d x) :
    ∃ x, x ∈ menu ∧ ∀ d, P d x := by
  classical
  induction menu with
  | nil =>
      obtain ⟨x, mem, _⟩ := every 0
      simp at mem
  | cons a rest ih =>
      by_cases all : ∀ d, P d a
      · exact ⟨a, by simp, all⟩
      · have bad : ∃ d, ¬ P d a := by
          by_cases witnessed : ∃ d, ¬ P d a
          · exact witnessed
          · apply False.elim
            apply all
            intro d
            by_cases hd : P d a
            · exact hd
            · exact False.elim (witnessed ⟨d, hd⟩)
        obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := bad
        have remaining : ∀ d, ∃ x, x ∈ rest ∧ P d x := by
          intro d
          obtain ⟨x, mem, hx⟩ := every (max d k)
          have neq : x ≠ a := by
            intro equal
            subst x
            exact hk (down k (max d k) a (Nat.le_max_right d k) hx)
          have tailmem : x ∈ rest := by
            rcases List.mem_cons.mp mem with equal | tail
            · exact False.elim (neq equal)
            · exact tail
          exact ⟨x, tailmem,
            down d (max d k) x (Nat.le_max_left d k) hx⟩
        obtain ⟨x, mem, hx⟩ := ih remaining
        exact ⟨x, by simp [mem], hx⟩

def CambrianExtendable {S : Nat → Type u}
    (R : (t : Nat) → S t → S (t+1) → Prop)
    (t : Nat) (s : S t) : Prop :=
  ∀ d, CambrianCanFollow R t d s

theorem cambrian_extendable_successor
    {S : Nat → Type u}
    (R : (t : Nat) → S t → S (t+1) → Prop)
    (menu : (t : Nat) → S t → List (S (t+1)))
    (complete : ∀ t s next, R t s next → next ∈ menu t s)
    (t : Nat) (s : S t) (deep : CambrianExtendable R t s) :
    ∃ next, R t s next ∧ CambrianExtendable R (t+1) next := by
  let P : Nat → S (t+1) → Prop := fun d next =>
    R t s next ∧ CambrianCanFollow R (t+1) d next
  have every : ∀ d, ∃ next, next ∈ menu t s ∧ P d next := by
    intro d
    obtain ⟨next, edge, path⟩ := deep (d+1)
    exact ⟨next, complete t s next edge, edge, path⟩
  have down : ∀ e d next, e ≤ d → P d next → P e next := by
    intro e d next order hp
    exact ⟨hp.1, cambrian_can_follow_truncate
      R d (t+1) next e order hp.2⟩
  obtain ⟨next, _, all⟩ :=
    cambrian_finite_coherent_choice (menu t s) P down every
  exact ⟨next, (all 0).1, fun d => (all d).2⟩

/-- Finitely branching realization for changing source types and arbitrary

theorem cambrian_nondeterministic_history_realization
    {S : Nat → Type u}
    (R : (t : Nat) → S t → S (t+1) → Prop)
    (menu : (t : Nat) → S t → List (S (t+1)))
    (complete : ∀ t s next, R t s next → next ∈ menu t s)
    (start : S 0) (deep : CambrianExtendable R 0 start) :
    ∃ history : (t : Nat) → S t,
      history 0 = start ∧ ∀ t, R t (history t) (history (t+1)) := by
  classical
  let E : Nat → Type u := fun t => {s : S t // CambrianExtendable R t s}
  let next : (t : Nat) → E t → E (t+1) := fun t state =>
    let witness := cambrian_extendable_successor
      R menu complete t state.val state.property
    ⟨Classical.choose witness, (Classical.choose_spec witness).2⟩
  let branch : (t : Nat) → E t :=
    fun t => Nat.rec (motive := fun t => E t)
      ⟨start, deep⟩ (fun t state => next t state) t
  refine ⟨fun t => (branch t).val, rfl, ?_⟩
  intro t
  change R t (branch t).val (next t (branch t)).val
  exact (Classical.choose_spec
    (cambrian_extendable_successor R menu complete
      t (branch t).val (branch t).property)).1

/-- A COMPLETE finite list of initial source states may supply different
states at each finite horizon.  Finite branching still forces one initial
state and one infinite source history; a uniform finite state bound is
not assumed. -/
theorem cambrian_finite_prefixes_realize_one_history
    {S : Nat → Type u}
    (R : (t : Nat) → S t → S (t+1) → Prop)
    (menu : (t : Nat) → S t → List (S (t+1)))
    (complete : ∀ t s next, R t s next → next ∈ menu t s)
    (initial : List (S 0))
    (prefixes : ∀ d, ∃ s, s ∈ initial ∧ CambrianCanFollow R 0 d s) :
    ∃ history : (t : Nat) → S t,
      history 0 ∈ initial ∧ ∀ t, R t (history t) (history (t+1)) := by
  obtain ⟨s, mem, deep⟩ := cambrian_finite_coherent_choice
    initial (fun d s => CambrianCanFollow R 0 d s)
    (fun e d s le path => cambrian_can_follow_truncate R d 0 s e le path)
    prefixes
  obtain ⟨history, start, lawful⟩ :=
    cambrian_nondeterministic_history_realization R menu complete s deep
  exact ⟨history, by rw [start]; exact mem, lawful⟩

      ⟨start, deep⟩ (fun t state => next t state) t
  refine ⟨fun t => (branch t).val, rfl, ?_⟩
  intro t
  change R t (branch t).val (next t (branch t)).val
  exact (Classical.choose_spec
    (cambrian_extendable_successor R menu complete
      t (branch t).val (branch t).property)).1

/-- A COMPLETE finite list of initial source states may supply different
states at each finite horizon.  Finite branching still forces one initial
state and one infinite source history; a uniform finite state bound is
not assumed. -/
theorem cambrian_finite_prefixes_realize_one_history
    {S : Nat → Type u}
    (R : (t : Nat) → S t → S (t+1) → Prop)
    (menu : (t : Nat) → S t → List (S (t+1)))
    (complete : ∀ t s next, R t s next → next ∈ menu t s)
    (initial : List (S 0))
    (prefixes : ∀ d, ∃ s, s ∈ initial ∧ CambrianCanFollow R 0 d s) :
    ∃ history : (t : Nat) → S t,
      history 0 ∈ initial ∧ ∀ t, R t (history t) (history (t+1)) := by
  obtain ⟨s, mem, deep⟩ := cambrian_finite_coherent_choice
    initial (fun d s => CambrianCanFollow R 0 d s)
    (fun e d s le path => cambrian_can_follow_truncate R d 0 s e le path)
    prefixes
  obtain ⟨history, start, lawful⟩ :=
    cambrian_nondeterministic_history_realization R menu complete s deep
  exact ⟨history, by rw [start]; exact mem, lawful⟩

def CambrianCountdown (_ : Nat) (x y : Nat) : Prop := x = y+1

/-- Sharp failure without a finite initial source menu: a natural
countdown admits depth d exactly when its original state is at least d. -/
theorem cambrian_countdown_depth_iff :
    ∀ d t s, CambrianCanFollow CambrianCountdown t d s ↔ d ≤ s := by
  intro d
  induction d with
  | zero =>
      intro t s
      constructor
      · intro _; exact Nat.zero_le s
      · intro _; trivial
  | succ d ih =>
      intro t s
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨next, edge, tail⟩
        have smaller := (ih (t+1) next).mp tail
        change s = next+1 at edge
        omega
      · intro le
        refine ⟨s-1, ?_, ?_⟩
        · change s = (s-1)+1
          omega
        · apply (ih (t+1) (s-1)).mpr
          omega

theorem cambrian_countdown_all_finite_depths :
    ∀ d, ∃ s, CambrianCanFollow CambrianCountdown 0 d s := by
  intro d
  exact ⟨d, (cambrian_countdown_depth_iff d 0 d).mpr (Nat.le_refl d)⟩

theorem cambrian_countdown_no_infinite_history :
    ¬ ∃ history : Nat → Nat,
      ∀ t, CambrianCountdown t (history t) (history (t+1)) := by
  rintro ⟨history, edges⟩
  have budget : ∀ n, history n + n = history 0 := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n ih =>
        have edge := edges n
        change history n = history (n+1)+1 at edge
        omega
  have exhausted := budget (history 0+1)
  omega

end ObservationalSUCC

/- Audit appendix. The runner prepends the exact new Cambrian module,
   so this file needs no import of a separately built local olean. -/
namespace CambrianAudit
open ObservationalSUCC

def GrowingState (t : Nat) : Type := Nat × Fin (t+1)
def GrowingZero (t : Nat) : Fin (t+1) := ⟨0, by omega⟩
def GrowingRelation (t : Nat) (s : GrowingState t)
    (next : GrowingState (t+1)) : Prop :=
  next.2.val = 0 ∧
    (next.1 = s.1+t+1 ∨ next.1 = s.1+t+2)
def GrowingMenu (t : Nat) (s : GrowingState t) :
    List (GrowingState (t+1)) :=
  [(s.1+t+1, GrowingZero (t+1)),
   (s.1+t+2, GrowingZero (t+1)),
   (s.1, GrowingZero (t+1))]

theorem growing_menu_complete :
    ∀ t s next, GrowingRelation t s next → next ∈ GrowingMenu t s := by
  intro t s next edge
  rcases edge with ⟨tag, first | second⟩
  · have equal : next = (s.1+t+1, GrowingZero (t+1)) := by
      apply Prod.ext
      · exact first
      · apply Fin.ext
        exact tag
    rw [equal]
    simp [GrowingMenu]
  · have equal : next = (s.1+t+2, GrowingZero (t+1)) := by
      apply Prod.ext
      · exact second
      · apply Fin.ext
        exact tag
    rw [equal]
    simp [GrowingMenu]

theorem growing_menu_contains_non_successor (t : Nat) (s : GrowingState t) :
    (s.1, GrowingZero (t+1)) ∈ GrowingMenu t s ∧
      ¬ GrowingRelation t s (s.1, GrowingZero (t+1)) := by
  constructor
  · simp [GrowingMenu]
  · intro edge
    rcases edge.2 with first | second <;> omega

theorem growing_relation_is_nondeterministic (t : Nat) (s : GrowingState t) :
    ∃ next other : GrowingState (t+1),
      GrowingRelation t s next ∧ GrowingRelation t s other ∧ next ≠ other := by
  refine ⟨(s.1+t+1, GrowingZero (t+1)),
    (s.1+t+2, GrowingZero (t+1)),
    ⟨rfl, Or.inl rfl⟩, ⟨rfl, Or.inr rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  intro equal
  have values := congrArg Prod.fst equal
  omega

theorem growing_can_follow : ∀ d t (s : GrowingState t),
    CambrianCanFollow GrowingRelation t d s := by
  intro d
  induction d with
  | zero => intro t s; trivial
  | succ d ih =>
      intro t s
      exact ⟨(s.1+t+1, GrowingZero (t+1)),
        ⟨rfl, Or.inl rfl⟩, ih (t+1) _⟩

theorem growing_infinite_state_history :
    ∃ history : (t : Nat) → GrowingState t,
      history 0 = (0, GrowingZero 0) ∧
        ∀ t, GrowingRelation t (history t) (history (t+1)) := by
  exact cambrian_nondeterministic_history_realization
    GrowingRelation GrowingMenu growing_menu_complete
    (0, GrowingZero 0) (fun d => growing_can_follow d 0 _)

/- A single fixed root has infinitely many successors. Every finite
   depth exists, yet no infinite branch does. -/
def InfiniteRootRelation (t x y : Nat) : Prop := t = 0 ∨ x = y+1

theorem countdown_embeds_after_root :
    ∀ d t s, 0 < t →
      CambrianCanFollow CambrianCountdown t d s →
      CambrianCanFollow InfiniteRootRelation t d s := by
  intro d
  induction d with
  | zero => intro t s _ _; trivial
  | succ d ih =>
      intro t s positive path
      obtain ⟨next, edge, tail⟩ := path
      exact ⟨next, Or.inr edge, ih (t+1) next (by omega) tail⟩

theorem infinite_root_arbitrarily_extendable :
    CambrianExtendable InfiniteRootRelation 0 0 := by
  intro depth
  cases depth with
  | zero => trivial
  | succ d =>
      exact ⟨d, Or.inl rfl,
        countdown_embeds_after_root d 1 d (by omega)
          ((cambrian_countdown_depth_iff d 1 d).mpr (Nat.le_refl d))⟩

theorem infinite_root_no_infinite_history :
    ¬ ∃ history : Nat → Nat,
      ∀ t, InfiniteRootRelation t (history t) (history (t+1)) := by
  rintro ⟨history, edges⟩
  apply cambrian_countdown_no_infinite_history
  refine ⟨fun n => history (n+1), ?_⟩
  intro n
  rcases edges (n+1) with zero | edge
  · omega
  · exact edge

def ListMaximum (xs : List Nat) : Nat := xs.foldr Nat.max 0

theorem listed_below_maximum (xs : List Nat) :
    ∀ x, x ∈ xs → x ≤ ListMaximum xs := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => intro x mem; simp at mem
  | cons a rest ih =>
      intro x mem
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp mem with equal | tail
      · subst x
        exact Nat.le_max_left a (ListMaximum rest)
      · exact Nat.le_trans (ih x tail) (Nat.le_max_right a (ListMaximum rest))

theorem infinite_root_has_no_finite_complete_menu (xs : List Nat) :
    ¬ ∀ next, InfiniteRootRelation 0 0 next → next ∈ xs := by
  intro complete
  have mem := complete (ListMaximum xs+1) (Or.inl rfl)
  have bound := listed_below_maximum xs (ListMaximum xs+1) mem
  omega

def Alternating (d : Nat) (x : Bool) : Prop :=
  if d = 0 then x = true else x = false

theorem alternating_every_depth_has_a_finite_menu_witness :
    ∀ d, ∃ x : Bool, x ∈ [true, false] ∧ Alternating d x := by
  intro d
  cases d with
  | zero => exact ⟨true, by simp, by simp [Alternating]⟩
  | succ n => exact ⟨false, by simp, by simp [Alternating]⟩

theorem alternating_no_uniform_witness :
    ¬ ∃ x : Bool, ∀ d, Alternating d x := by
  rintro ⟨x, all⟩
  have first := all 0
  have second := all 1
  simp [Alternating] at first second
  rw [first] at second
  cases second

theorem alternating_lacks_downward_closure :
    ¬ ∀ e d x, e ≤ d → Alternating d x → Alternating e x := by
  intro down
  have impossible := down 0 1 false (by decide) (by simp [Alternating])
  simp [Alternating] at impossible
